title: Generator overrides
description: The only hand-maintained generator input. Every entry is a reviewed decision; an entry that matches nothing fails generation.

unions.description: IR path -> C# type for a construct the type mapping cannot map (union, any, unknown, a template property whose kind differs across backends). Value: a fully qualified hand-written type such as Graspea.Flint.ContinuousMarkCrossSection, or JsonNode for an explicitly accepted opaque member.

flatten.description: IR paths of mapped types (Omit, Pick, Partial of a non-reference) accepted as a generated class <Parent><Prop> with the checker-resolved members.

dedup.description: Fully qualified hand-written type -> IR paths of inline objects that are structurally identical to it (ChartSize: required numeric width and height).

renames.description: IR path (type member, catalog constant, or <Template>/property/<key>, <Template>/channel/<channel>, <Template>/enum/<key>, <Template>/enum/<key>/<value>) -> C# name. Template paths rename the builder method of a channel or property, the enum of a discrete property, or one enum member (the value is the raw string, or the JSON of another value); the wire value never changes.

docs.description: IR path (type or type member) -> remark text for a fact the d.ts gets wrong or omits.

backendsApplyingTheme.description: Backends that read theme_spec (backed by the recorded probe); copied into IR catalog.

hostStateKeys.description: chartProperties keys read even where a template does not declare them; copied into IR catalog.

ignoredOptions.description: AssembleOptions member -> backends that overwrite it; copied into IR catalog and the member docs.

keepObsolete.description: Rename paths whose old shipped name is kept as an [Obsolete] FLINT0002 member.
